sourceControl.rule: Preserve permanent THC-ENC IDs and controlled titles; separate symptoms, signs, organism detection, pathogenicity, environmental favorability, and laboratory confirmation; do not convert pathogen detection into automatic causation or regulated-product authorization.

educationalBoundary: Plant pathology, disease recognition, diagnostic reasoning, and lawful integrated-disease-management education only. Pesticide, biopesticide, disinfectant, and other regulated product use remains governed by current labels, registrations, worker-safety requirements, residue rules, and jurisdictional law. Detection of an organism, environmental risk factor, or symptom does not by itself establish causation or a treatment requirement.
